main_text.head: Paraphrasis.
main_text.p: Ausus, o Amor Sapientiæ, ad te tuosq; candidos collegas, Veritatis intaminatos sacerdotes, in jus adire: aufus ego perfidos illos, & se patronis suis necquidquam efferentes veteratores, capitis anquirere: Te ipso adductus pulcerrimo judice, fretus optimâ caussâ, eorumque, quos in consilium adhibes, summâ sanctimoniâ.
main_text.head: Commentarius.
main_text.p: (1.) Pedum (id est baculus pastoralis) insigne pastoris est, qui dux quidam suarum ovium: (2.) Indicem (id est digitum pollici proximum) ad viam intendere, & insigne ducis est, & etiam munus: (3.) Dexteram manum axillæ inserere, & ita sustentare gressum ejus, quem dirigas, ducis item.

page.notes: Catchword and running text end at "item." The word "item" at the foot right is a catchword-like marker set in the text block; the left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Greek and italic letters as printed; the printed "sustentare" line is partly obscured at its start.
